sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN INDUSTRIES DEPARTMENT
BALOCHISTAN INDUSTRIES
DEPARTMENT
(GRADE 16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE
RULES, 1983
(Amendment of Appendix)
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary,
18th December, 2011]
No.
SORII(10)14/S&GAD/219-70, dated 18-1-2011.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 25 of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (IX of
1974), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following
amendments in the Balochistan Industries Department (Grade 16 and above)
Service Rules, 1983, namely:--
In
the aforesaid rules, in the Appendix, the existing serial numbers 1, 2, 3, 4,
5, 6 (inadvertently mentioned 7 instead of 6), 7, 8, 9 and 10 shall be
renumbered as serial numbers 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12 and 13, respectively and
thereafter,--
(a) before
Sr. No.3 as renumbered here above, the following new entries shall be inserted,
namely:--
1.
Director General (B-20)
---
By transfer from amongst the officers of BSS/BCS/DMG.
2.
Director (B-19)
---
By Promotion from amongst the members of the Service
holding the post of Deputy Director (B-18) having at least 12 years service
in B-17 and above, on seniority cum fitness basis.
(b) against
the entries at Sr. Nos.3, 5, 8 and 9 as renumbered here above, the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
3.
Deputy Director (B-18)
---
By promotion from amongst the members of the Service
holding the posts of Assistant Director (B-17), Assistant Director Statistics
(B-17) and Administrative Officer (B-17) having at least 5 years service as
such, on seniority cum fitness basis
5.
Assistant Director (B-17)
2nd Class Master Degree in Economics, M.Com; or MBA from
a recognized University.
(a) 50% by initial recruitment; and (b) 50% by promotion
from amongst the members of the Service holding the posts of
Superintendent (B-16) and Assistant
Accounts Officer (B-16) having at least 3 years service as such, on
seniority cum fitness basis.
8.
Assistant Director Statistic (B-17)
---
By promotion from amongst the members of the Service
holding the post of Industrial Development Officer (B-16) having at least 3
Years service as such, on seniority cum- fitness basis.
9.
Administrative Officer (B-17)
---
By promotion from amongst the members of the
Service holding the post of
Superintendent (B16) having at least 3 years service as such, on seniority
cum fitness basis.
(C) After
Sr. No.9 as amended hereabove, the following new entries shall be inserted at
serial number 10, namely:--
10.
Law Officer (B-17)
(a) B.A. LL.B from a recognized University; and (b) at
least two years practice as an Advocate.
By initial recruitment.
